note: Chat Completions publishes no version header at all, so the date is the whole identity. OpenRouter adds vendor extensions on top of the OpenAI contract, and the rows below are those, read from the real arm captures in testdata/provider/openrouter. The request leg has no rows because no Chat-format client capture exists on disk; the cell's Chat traffic is what it encodes, not what a client sent. The stream leg repeats most of the response leg because a streamed response is decoded through chatChunkWire and a non-streamed one through chatResponseWire: production prunes each against its own struct, so a row on one says nothing about the other. Every row drops on every target: an unmodelled provider member is pruned before decode, so it reaches no client, not even a Chat client.
